name: shop-serve~p1
task: Each time a client arrives, take their order, get food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove and hand it over; should the food fall, your very next move must pick it up.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands every client to be served, but only one client is served in the environment. Add a hard Existence(order_served) to make sure every client is served, and keep the hard RespondedExistence for the client that arrives first. The machine has no final state because the task requires every client to be served, but the environment only serves one client. The rule-only warning is correct, but the task requires every client to be served, so the machine should have a final state.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires serving the client, but no clause makes it happen; FINAL_STATES is empty. Add a hard Existence(order_served); with Response(client_arrived, order_taken) it also forces order_taken, and with Response(order_taken, food_prepared) and Response(food_prepared, order_served) it forces food_prepared and order_served.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires to pick up food that falls, but the machine only rewards it if the agent has food, and the rule to pick it up only applies when the agent has food too. Add a rule that requires to pick up food that falls, even if the agent does not have food; keep the other rules as they are.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the clauses together capture the task: each client arrives, the agent takes the order, gets food from the pantry, prepares it at the stove and serves it, and in case the food falls, the very next move must pick it up.
